<Intro>
Inspect and update the sources, versions, and file-selection settings in your vendoring manifests.
Use these commands to automate dependency configuration changes while preserving the YAML's comments
and structure.
</Intro>

<CastPlayer title="atmos vendor config --help" src="/casts/screengrabs/atmos-vendor-config--help.cast" static chrome />

## Usage

Address fields in `vendor.yaml` using dot-notation paths, such as `spec.sources[0].version`, source URLs, tags, or `included_paths`. For a component's pinned version, [`atmos vendor get`](/cli/commands/vendor/vendor-get) and [`atmos vendor set`](/cli/commands/vendor/vendor-set) accept its name instead of a manifest index. Use `atmos vendor config` directly for other fields and for `list` or `format`.

```shell
atmos vendor config get <path> [--file <manifest>]
atmos vendor config set <path> <value> [--type <type>] [--file <manifest>]
atmos vendor config delete <path> [--file <manifest>]
atmos vendor config format [--file <manifest>]
atmos vendor config list [path-pattern] [--format <format>] [--file <manifest>]
```

## Subcommands

<DocCardList />

## Examples

```shell
# Read a raw value by path.
atmos vendor config get spec.sources[0].version

# Set a raw value by path.
atmos vendor config set spec.sources[0].version v1.2.3

# Delete a raw value by path.
atmos vendor config delete spec.sources[0].tags

# Format the root and imported vendor manifest files.
atmos vendor config format

# List every editable path across the vendor manifest set.
atmos vendor config list
```
